bodyContent.heading: Stop Water Damage Before It Spreads
bodyContent.intro: Standing water soaks into subfloor, drywall and insulation within the first hour, and mold can start growing in 24 to 48 hours. Dry County Restoration removes the water, maps where moisture traveled, and dries your home to measured standards. Call now and our Corona crew can begin extraction the same day.

We work with all insurance carriers
bodyContent.callout: If water is still moving in your home, call Dry County Restoration now at (951) 667-9910.

processSteps.title: Emergency Extraction
processSteps.body: Standing water comes out first with submersible pumps and truck-mounted extractors to limit how far it spreads.

processSteps.title: Moisture Mapping
processSteps.body: Thermal imaging and moisture meters find hidden water in walls, under cabinets and in subfloor, and confirm the water category.

processSteps.title: Monitored Structural Drying
processSteps.body: Dehumidifiers and air movers are placed to IICRC S500 guidelines, with daily readings to track progress.

processSteps.title: Documentation for Insurance
processSteps.body: Final moisture readings and a full drying report go to your insurance carrier to support your claim.

bodyContent.heading: Find the Leak Without Tearing Your Home Apart
bodyContent.intro: A water bill that jumped for no reason, a warm spot on the slab, or a musty smell can mean a leak is running behind a wall or under the foundation. We locate the source with non-invasive tools before anything gets opened up. You get a written report so the repair can start without guesswork.
bullets: Thermal imaging, acoustic sensors and moisture meters
Slab leak detection with electromagnetic locating
Written report with photos and thermal images
bodyContent.callout: Spotted a damp patch or a strange water bill? Call Dry County Restoration 24/7 to get it checked.

processSteps.title: Symptom Review
processSteps.body: We start with what you have noticed, like a spiking water bill, a damp patch or the sound of running water.

processSteps.title: Non-Invasive Scanning
processSteps.body: Thermal imaging and acoustic sensors scan walls, slab and ceilings before any cutting happens.

processSteps.title: Isolate and Pinpoint
processSteps.body: We pressure test plumbing zones and use electromagnetic locators to mark the exact point of failure.

processSteps.title: Report and Handoff
processSteps.body: You get a written report with location, likely cause and images, ready for your plumber or our restoration team.
